title: BARCELONA WANT BAYERN'S TAH. BAYERN REPORTEDLY WANT TO KEEP HIM
description:
Asking is free. Getting a yes is a different job.

Sky Sports Deutschland reports that Barcelona have asked about Bayern's centre-back Jonathan Tah, who is thirty. The reason, reportedly: Deco wants an experienced defender next to Pau Cubarsí. A grown-up for the back line, basically.

Bayern have little interest in selling. Tah's contract runs to 2029 and he isn't considering a move. So that's a no, with extra paperwork. Levi Colwill is also linked, but he's reportedly close to a new deal. Two names, zero yeses.
